description: Groups @commercetools/nimbus* packages with the external peers they're tightly version-coupled to

packageRules.description: @commercetools/nimbus, nimbus-icons, and nimbus-tokens are released in lockstep from the same monorepo (commercetools/nimbus) and are currently at the identical upstream version. @chakra-ui/react and the slate family are nimbus's declared peerDependencies with narrow version ranges (nimbus pins slate/slate-react to a single 0.x minor, for example) - splitting a non-major bump of one package in this set from a still-gated major bump of another installs mismatched versions. Same failure mode as libraries/graphiql.json.
